sender_role: Fractional COO | Operations Consultant | Transformation Partner
sender_summary: Chris Ringenberg is an experienced Fractional COO and Operations Consultant who embeds with real estate investment and private equity firms to build scalable operational infrastructure. He specializes in portfolio operations architecture, asset management reporting systems, cross-functional process design, and leading transformation initiatives for asset-heavy organizations navigating growth. Chris works with leadership teams who have a clear acquisition and value-add thesis but need operational depth to execute it consistently — building the systems, reporting frameworks, and team structures that turn strategy into measurable portfolio performance.
receiver_role: Managing Director - Head of Asset and Portfolio Management
receiver_summary: Stephen Orullian is the Managing Director and Head of Asset and Portfolio Management at BMC Investments, a Denver-based commercial real estate investment and development firm active across multifamily and mixed-use assets in the Mountain West and Sun Belt. In his role, Stephen owns the operational and financial performance of BMC's entire portfolio — overseeing NOI optimization, capex planning, budget variance analysis, third-party property manager relationships, and value-add execution across assets. He bridges acquisitions, development, and capital markets teams, ensuring that assets perform against underwriting and that portfolio-level decisions are grounded in real-time operational data. As BMC's portfolio scales, his challenge is building the operational infrastructure — systems, processes, reporting, and team capacity — to manage growing complexity without a proportional increase in overhead or erosion of returns.
outreach_goal: Book a 20-minute discovery conversation to explore whether Chris's Fractional COO model can help BMC Investments build the operational infrastructure needed to manage a scaling portfolio more efficiently and maintain performance consistency across assets
offer: Chris Ringenberg offers embedded Fractional COO and operational consulting engagements for real estate investment firms. The work is not advisory — it is execution-focused operational leadership that sits inside the organization. Engagements are scoped around specific outcomes: building portfolio-level reporting and performance visibility systems, standardizing asset management processes and capex workflows, building team structure and capacity to manage growing portfolios, or leading defined operational transformation initiatives. For real estate firms managing expanding asset bases in high-growth markets, Chris provides the senior operational depth to match the pace of the investment strategy — without the cost or commitment of a full-time COO hire.
asset_name: The Portfolio Operations Maturity Model — a diagnostic framework for real estate investment firms scaling from 10 to 50+ assets across multiple markets
pain_points: Portfolio growth is outpacing operational infrastructure — reporting is fragmented across third-party PMs, processes are ad-hoc by property, and the data needed for confident portfolio-level capital allocation decisions is slower to arrive than the pace of acquisitions demands, Asset management performance visibility is siloed — no consolidated view across properties and operators means variance analysis, capex decisions, and NOI optimization are reactive rather than proactive, leaving return compression undetected until month-end or quarter-end reviews, The team and systems that worked at a smaller portfolio size are becoming the constraint as BMC scales — compounding operational inefficiency quietly erodes returns and stretches the senior team thin on coordination work instead of value creation work
tone: Executive-level and consultative — direct peer-to-peer between two senior operators, insight-first with no generic compliments or fluff, grounded in the specific financial and operational reality of running a growing real estate investment portfolio in competitive Sun Belt and Mountain West markets
